# myjfrog_ip_ranges (Data Source)

Provides a list of MyJFrog [IP ranges](https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-rest-apis/ip-ranges). This data source does not require authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "myjfrog_ip_ranges" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ip_ranges` (Attributes List) List of IP ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_ranges))

<a id="nestedatt--ip_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (List of String) List of CIDR blocks.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider.
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `service` (String) Service name.
